text:
showDetails
          ? t("savedDetails.title")
          : detailProposalId
            ? t("savedDetails.reviewTitle")
            : stepProposalId
              ? t("taskSteps.reviewTitle")
              : plan
                ? "proposalId" in plan
                  ? t("plans.reviewTitle")
                  : t("plans.planTitle")
                : proposalId
                  ? proposalKind === "task_edit"
                    ? t("taskEdit.drawerTitle")
                    : t("taskCreate.drawerTitle")
                  : selected
                    ? t("taskActions.drawerTitle")
                    : t("taskActions.listTitle")
